completeCurrentCard.procedure:
KEEP both source placements, Action, 60 feet, V/S/F and concentration up to one minute. NEW choose one willing creature, including yourself, perceived within 60 feet and line of effect. The casting range selects that recipient; a separate NEW 60-foot sensory extent moves with its actual body. Combine both preserved placements' explicit benefits into this single identity: darkness, all illusions, invisibility, shapechanges and transmutations. This proposed union does not grant an unacquired school or class mode. There is no save for a willing recipient, and the benefit requires no continuing range tether to the caster.

Within the extent and actual unobstructed sensory path, the recipient sees normally through ordinary or magical darkness, sees actually Invisible creatures/objects, and perceives sensory illusions as identifiable false overlays. Darkness removal is observer-specific and casts no light for others. It does not penetrate actual opaque barriers, physical smoke/fog or opaque mundane material. Blinded or missing usable sight still prevents sight; darkness alone is bypassed, not the Blinded condition. Normal hearing or another genuinely functioning sense can identify an illusory sound/tactile impression whose actual apparent source lies within the extent and accessible sensory path, without gaining hearing while Deafened or receiving messages through walls. An existing remote sensor does not acquire this effect or move its extent; its own express sharing rules must supply any separate permission.

NEW the recipient sees the underlying original appearance beneath an actually operative shapechange/transmutation, including an ongoing permanent form spell. The body remains in its current mechanical form with its actual HP, anatomy, equipment and permissions. This reveals appearance only, not a name, history, alignment, motives, creature statistics, identity documents or lost earlier transformations. A completed instantaneous conversion that now leaves ordinary matter supplies no ongoing false form to pierce. Seeing an original silhouette does not find hidden objects inside the body or restore missing matter. Physical concealment/Hidden still needs ordinary detection; an invisible creature is not automatically found through cover. Once genuinely seen, its Invisible-specific unseen modifiers are bypassed for this observer within the benefit's scope.

For current visual illusions, this is conclusive personal identification without an examination Action. Identification removes only perception-dependent deception and any consequence whose own source explicitly ends on disbelief. It does not dispel the source for other observers or cancel an independently specified psychic packet, fear relation or compulsion. NEW explicit bridge to the unadopted Mental Prison proposal: a recipient seeing through its own subjective prison leaves that illusion mentally; the prison's one still-live ordinary exit packet resolves under its own rule, rather than treating True Seeing as antimagic. Greater Phantasmal Killer's independent damage proposal and Spectral Army's explicit detonation remain capable of damage. These cross-proposal choices await joint review. Concentration ending, expiry, actual removal or recipient death ends this sight. Suppression suspends it while the clock continues. Separate True Seeing sources add no range and retain independent endings; renewed paid casts grant no new knowledge beyond present actual perception.

IP14-SOURCE1-casting.completeText: KEEP each actual class access row, rank 4/base 7 RP, minimum class level and repertoire. All thirteen use Action and V/S/F; Summon Corpse Golem preserves V/S/M/F with the existing unpriced material-or-focus alternative. The ordinary casting engine, actual hand/voice/focus requirements, RP discounts and surcharges, Dissonance/Refrain and source hooks apply. Observable legality precedes commitment; hidden defenses or concealed ineligibility give no free diagnostic or refund. Commit the actual Action, costs and cadence before the counter window. A concentration cast displaces incompatible old concentration at commitment even if countered. Attack modifier is actual source PB plus casting modifier; save DC is 8 plus those values. Saves are binary, without natural-die degree shifts. No generic upcast, level scaling, extra turn or unacquired source is supplied.
IP14-SOURCE1-casting.scope: Only listed accepted Illusion14 cards. Named rules for other cards grant no capability here. Actual accepted interfaces and each selected current procedure control their explicit scopes and exceptions.

IP14-SOURCE1-clocks.completeText: NEW for these cards, durations expressed in minutes/hours use absolute elapsed deadlines from resolution: one minute is sixty seconds and one hour is 3,600 seconds. Expiry precedes a use scheduled at exactly that deadline. A hostile one-round rider uses the first future target regular END excluding the in-progress turn; N future target-end installments use precisely N such endpoints. Outside initiative use the stated 6N seconds. Preserve the chosen virtual marker or absolute deadline through reordering, extra turns, absence, entry and exit from initiative. NEW attached-asset bridge for Mind Maze and Leeching Plague: if the recipient has only a real original-owner attached phase, use its next future attached-phase END excluding a phase already underway; if it has no real turn/phase, use six-second END-only checkpoints. There is no concentration; this ongoing rank-4 rider expressly survives the original Instantaneous metadata and is subject to qualifying removal/suppression. It prohibits new full Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions and voluntary movement commitments. Already legally committed Actions/Reactions finish their actual resolution; movement already spent is not refunded, while later uncommitted movement cannot begin. Extra turns inside the interval gain no exception and do not shorten the endpoint. The target still makes actual required saves, death saves and ending checks, can perceive/think and use permitted speech, retains passive defenses and can be moved by independent forces. Suppression permits whatever normal actions are otherwise legal while suppressed, without restoring budgets already spent or extending the endpoint. The used hard-control allowance remains used after early removal or suppression. No repeat save is added; expiry/removal/death of the recipient ends the rider. No teleportation or stopped personal time occurs.

completeCurrentCard.procedure: Action; range 60 feet; V/S/F. KEEP one clone mimicking the caster and a place swap once per round. NEW create one visual-only duplicate of your actual current body and gear appearance at a perceived position within sixty feet and line of effect, with enough geometric room for the depicted body. It has your current silhouette and occupied dimensions, but no creature identity, HP, physical gear, collision, attack, senses or targetable creature status. Replace Instantaneous with concentration up to sixty seconds. Its pose and gestures mirror your visible bodily motion without duplicating speech, light or effects. NEW when you perform actual self-powered movement, it translates by the same vector, segment by segment, preserving its offset; a segment that would move it outside sixty feet, through an actual solid barrier or out of caster line of effect leaves it at its last legal image position. It then keeps mimicking in place until a later legal segment; it banks no missed movement. Forced displacement and teleportation do not translate it. It has no independent move command or initiative budget. Once on your own regular turn, spend an available Bonus Action to exchange your actual position with the clone’s current depicted position. Both positions must still be perceived and within sixty feet/line of effect, the arrival must legally fit your actual full body and carried noncreature gear, and actual relocation prohibitions must permit it. NEW supported destinations are required unless you already have a legal flight/hover or other support mode for that actual arrival. The swap is instantaneous, has no path traversal/opportunity attack and moves no carried creature or mount. The new image occupies your old location; it does not trigger a second translation. Commit the Bonus Action and the character-wide Illusory Clone swap allowance before resolving an eligible swap; later prevention refunds neither. The allowance is once per numbered round across casts, owners of copied permission and extra turns; outside initiative use the continuing six-second action budget and preserve the open allowance on transition. Casting can be followed by a swap if the real Bonus Action remains. The clone can be scrutinized/contradicted under the shared illusion rules. It supplies no Mirror Image random interception, mis-targeting requirement, invisibility, attack defense or ability to swap in response to a hit. Suppression prevents visual operation and swapping, while maintaining the last position, original clock and spent swap history; resumption does not catch up movement.

completeCurrentCard.procedure:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, one target's movement controlled for two rounds and STR resistance. NEW select one perceived creature with line of effect. No shared language, hearing, particular limb count or humanoid anatomy is required; actual locomotion still needs its own real anatomy and permissions. The target makes initial STR. Success establishes nothing. Failure establishes a movement-only compulsion, nonconcentration, through its second future original regular-turn END, excluding an already-underway turn. Outside initiative its original maximum is twelve elapsed seconds. It may repeat STR at the first affected future regular END before that maximum; success ends this application. Expiry wins at the second END, so no useless final save or extra turn is generated.

NEW at each of the target's next two future regular STARTs after normal start processing, a conscious capable caster who currently perceives the target within 60 feet and line of effect may issue one exact finite route through terrain the caster actually knows. It costs no extra Action/Bonus Action, but is only an instruction opportunity, not a fresh movement budget. The route uses the target's real available movement modes and ordinary movement allowance on that turn. Execute as much legal route as possible before contradictory voluntary movement, competing through ordinary Compelled Budget Arbitration with the timestamp of this particular route's issue. The target/controller supplies safe legal details not fixed by the route. No valid current order means ordinary movement agency for that opportunity; old orders do not automatically repeat, and recovering consciousness later in a turn creates no missed START opportunity. For an independent-turn creature outside initiative, NEW explicitly bind these route opportunities to the reviewed shared six-second control cycle. With no existing cycle, the first START is immediately after successful resolution, its END at +6 seconds, and the second START follows that END. With an existing cycle, never replay its already-passed START or refill its movement; only the next two future STARTs before the original twelve-second maximum can supply orders. The first END belonging to an actually affected future opportunity supplies the early STR save. On entering initiative, carry the existing opportunity and spent budget under the reviewed mapping; ordinary real-start events still occur but no control START or movement refills twice.

The caster controls the instructed ordinary path, including legal walking, swimming, climbing, flying, crawling or standing when the existing movement rules permit them. It cannot grant a missing movement mode, activate a finite flight ability, force Dash/Disengage, take an Action, spend RP, compel teleportation or commandeer an attack. Ordinary movement costs, actual remaining Speed, difficult terrain, occupied spaces, anchors and grapple limits apply. Speed zero can leave no executable travel. A blocked segment permits only actual safe progress along the same instruction; no substitute destination, accumulated displacement or extra off-turn movement is banked. No knowingly self-destructive route, unsupported suicidal step, known serious hazard, protected secret or prohibited resource expenditure can be forced. Ordinary opportunity attacks remain possible. This is compelled use of movement and cannot invoke the no-opportunity-attack rule for pushes/pulls.

Movement acquired by a voluntarily chosen Dash or other genuine later permission stays real but cannot be spent contrary to the current route while its movement instruction remains operative; the spell cannot compel the Action or resource needed to obtain that extra allowance. An independently legal teleport is not ordinary movement expenditure and is not controlled by this source. At turn end the issued route expires. Losing the caster's observation after a valid route was issued does not rewrite it or create remote information; the next route still needs fresh actual eligibility. This profile is not whole-Action denial, Speed reduction, Root or Restrained, so it claims no hard-control allowance merely for controlling movement.

For an owner-attached companion, NEW substitute its next two original-owner regular attached phases for the two START opportunities and those phase endings for the finite two-round marker/save bridge. It receives only the movement its actual chassis already allows, not an independent turn, owner Bonus Action charge, new command/offensive allowance or extra phase. The absolute twelve-second outside-initiative maximum persists; absent original phases cannot be invented. A genuinely established later Puppet Strings from the same caster replaces that caster's older application on the same target; other casters retain independent orders but share the same actual movement budget. Suppression at an order opportunity loses that opportunity; suppression during execution releases only the then-current compulsion while spent movement remains spent. A still-live issued route may resume within its same actual turn if suppression ends, but no already-passed opportunity replays. Removal, target death or expiry ends the application; caster incapacity prevents further orders without itself creating a concentration loss. The strings are an incorporeal control description, not cuttable rope or a machine with HP.

CTRL15-PUPPET-END-01 — scoped authored completion for Puppet Strings only. Record the two original future movement opportunities and the first one's ending-save checkpoint independently of whether a route will be issued or executed. An already-underway turn or attached phase when the effect establishes is neither future opportunity and grants no retrospective route or early save. At the first recorded eligible future regular END, or the END of the first actual future original-owner attached phase for an attached companion, offer this application's one early STR ending save if it still exists and the original expiry has not occurred. This END save requires neither a successful START instruction nor actual travel. Suppression at that START, no conscious/perceiving caster, Grappled/Speed zero, an unavailable route or a lost movement budget cannot postpone the checkpoint to a later opportunity or remove the save. The existing scheduled-save-during-suppression rule also applies when suppression continues across this END. A successful save ends this application; failure leaves only its original remaining opportunity and original deadline. At the second original END, expiry occurs first and no redundant final save is rolled. Missing real companion phases create no extra phase, order, movement, ordinary START/END trigger or resource refresh; no END-only substitute for an absent attached phase is granted by this Puppet-only completion. Preserve the original maximum/expiry marker under the existing timing contract. In EN6-03-B, release at 2.2 excludes the underway phase ending 2.4; suppression over START 8 loses that route, but END 8.4 still offers the original early STR save, and expiry stays 14.4.

completeCurrentCard.procedure:
KEEP both Enchantment and Illusion placements, Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, one target trapped in an illusory reality and 5d10 psychic when entering or leaving. NEW select one perceived creature with line of effect and make an initial INT save. Success establishes no prison and deals no damage. On failure, if a genuine mental/illusion defense does not prevent entry, establish one subjective prison around that target. The fixed real boundary is the target's current axis-aligned occupied-body bounding box expanded five feet in each direction; it is not a physical wall, object, dimensional pocket or plane. Record the actual shape/anchor before damage. The caster's concentration maintains it for at most sixty elapsed seconds, an explicitly NEW duration replacing the preserved Instantaneous placeholder.

NEW entering is actual first establishment of this illusory state, not later movement into its former footprint by anyone else. On that one entry, deal 5d10 psychic to the recipient as an ordinary defended packet, with no second damage save. Its psychic immunity can prevent damage without preventing the separately admitted illusion. Charmed-only/Frightened-only immunity is not automatically illusion immunity. A defense that truly prevents the mental illusion prevents entry and its entry-triggered damage. Actual target death from entry ends the application with no postmortem exit packet.

Within the prison the target perceives its real interior occupants and objects, but a convincing opaque enclosure replaces its visual/auditory perception of the exterior. The invented enclosure grants no real cover, collision, sound barrier or support to anyone. Genuine unaffected nonvisual senses retain their real scope. The target cannot willingly move, self-teleport or accept transport across the fixed boundary while that belief/control component remains operative. It can move legally inside, speak, take other permitted Actions/Bonus Actions/Reactions, maintain concentration, and interact with actual interior targets. No Charmed, Frightened, Restrained, Speed zero or Incapacitated is added. Perception-dependent attacks/spells need actual available perception; attacks through the nonexistent physical wall otherwise obey their real unseen-target/line rules. Because ordinary Actions remain available and only a voluntary boundary/perception restriction is imposed, this proposed profile spends no whole-Action denial allowance. It creates no permission for a broader hard prison if a future implementation chooses to remove all Actions.

NEW the target may spend its ordinary Action examining the contradictions and make an INT/Investigation task check against the original spell DC. Success/Critical Success recognizes and leaves this mental state immediately; failure uses that Action and permits a fresh attempt on a later actual Action while the prison remains. This is an express repeatable escape action, not a generic unchanged-evidence skill retry. An actual source that specifically defeats the illusion retains its own success/removal permission; knowing that illusions exist alone is not a free removal. No external advice can forge a successful roll, though real evidence can support a separately applicable ordinary assistance rule.

NEW leaving is the first actual termination of the admitted mental state, including a successful escape, crossing its fixed boundary through independently legal involuntary displacement/teleport, normal expiry, replacement, voluntary dismissal or loss of concentration. That first departure deals one 5d10 psychic packet, then ends this application; a new real position outside the footprint never snaps back. Mark the exit entitlement spent before resolving the packet. The event has at most one entry and one exit packet per cast/recipient, no repeat crossing damage and no recursive exit on death caused by the exit packet. A target can be harmed on an ordinary ending even without physically moving; this is an explicit consequential reading of the entering/leaving clause. Suppression or an actually eligible dispel/removal that disables this source before departure prevents the exit payload and consumes that entitlement without banking it. Target death/removal also ends without a corpse packet.

If only temporarily suppressed, its original clock/concentration remain. It can resume the same still-live subjective boundary only if the continuing target is still within it; the entry does not replay and the already consumed exit entitlement cannot return. A target leaving the footprint during suppression ends the prison permanently; returning later is not a new entry. NEW only one Mental Prison can be established on a target across casters. A new failed-save, otherwise admissible application first ends/replaces the old one through its real exit procedure; after those consequences, recheck the same target's continuing eligibility before establishing the new entry. A saved-against or blocked new attempt replaces nothing. This makes repeated paid casts real separate events without infinite boundary or suppression loops. Real body position, other effects, resources and material evidence remain unchanged by the invented scenery.

CTRL15-PRISON-ROOT-01 — scoped authored completion for Mental Prison only. On actual admission of one cast's prison to one recipient, after the initial save and entry-preventing defenses and before its entry damage, create one damage root owned by the original Mental Prison caster. Capture nullNonlethal from that dealer's actual unsuppressed Null Veil state at this creation event under the existing Null Veil contract. Record the cast, application, recipient, root and one unspent exit entitlement. No admitted prison means no entry damage root or deferred exit entitlement. The entry and eventual exit are two distinct damage events under this same root, not a combined hit and not two new casts. The exit inherits the stored nullNonlethal flag: later gaining, losing or suppressing the caster's Veil does not recapture it. Caster death or removal from the live initiative roster does not delete that root's original dealer identity or change the stored flag. Apply current recipient state and current applicable damage defenses separately at each actual packet; Wounds, concentration and life-state consequences remain event-local. This introduces no new class proc or resource permission and does not generalize Spectral Army's explicitly separate later-discharge roots.

Before any exit damage, atomically consume that application's exit entitlement and mark departure in progress. Duplicate cleanup, concurrent departure reasons and reentrant damage/death callbacks cannot emit another exit. A true entry-death or independently established target death/removal ends the application without an exit packet; zero HP without actual death is not itself this exception. Source-disabling suppression or an eligible source-disabling removal consumes the entitlement without creating an exit damage event or rolling exit dice. A suppressed prison that lawfully resumes uses the same original root and boundary; it restores neither entry damage nor the consumed exit. Complete an already admitted departure event without recursive cleanup; ordinary eligible packet prevention and the existing damage/life response sequence still apply.

Replacement follows the ordinary casting transaction before any source-specific replacement rule. If the NEW caster was maintaining the OLD prison, committing another concentration spell already ends that old concentration before the new spell's counter window, save or admission. Its legitimate unsuppressed old exit resolves as that independent ending; a later counter, successful new save or blocked new application never restores it. The statement that a saved-against attempt replaces nothing refers only to replacement-by-admission, not this earlier concentration displacement. If another caster's old prison still exists, a newly failed-save and otherwise admissible application first fully resolves the old departure and its ordinary responses; then rechecks the same recipient's continuing life/identity, the new cast's continuing concentration/source availability and its actual admission predicates. Do not reroll the new admission save, choose a replacement recipient, refund payment or create the new root/entry if those predicates now fail. Only a still-legal new admission creates its own distinct root using its own caster's state at that later admission. Thus old exit and new entry retain their separate event order and may have different root flags.

The exact True Seeing bridge already selected in Illusion/Perception14 Exact13 is a recognition/mental-departure interaction, not a dispel or source-disabling suppression. When that exact bridge actually applies to this still-admitted prison, use the same one live exit entitlement and stored root. A previously consumed entitlement produces no further damage. This adopts no other illusion bypass and supplies no missing Mental Prison or True Seeing acquisition. The full Control15 candidate remains pending its separate complete acceptance; this paragraph settles only the named causality/termination integration.

workedCases: EN6-05-A: A target fails INT and actually enters the prison. The entry roll is 28 psychic before defenses. On its turn it spends its ordinary Action on Investigation, succeeds against DC16, and leaves the mental state; the independently rolled exit is 24 psychic before defenses. That cast produced at most52 raw psychic across its two actual events, not an additional 10d10 burst or recurring boundary tick. The escape Action was available because the prison did not impose Incapacitated.

EN6-05-B: After entry, an eligible suppression field disables this prison. The departure entitlement is consumed with no suppressed exit damage. If the target remains inside and suppression ends before the original deadline, the same state may resume without new entry damage; its eventual exit has no refunded packet. completeCurrentCard.procedure:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F, a target using all Actions to dance and WIS ending saves. NEW select one perceived creature with line of effect and make an initial WIS save. Success establishes nothing; the title does not remove that initial resistance. On failure, attempt one whole-Action denial component under the shared source-character/target/encounter allowance and actual relevant defenses. If prevented or that allowance is already spent, establish no Dance and no invented soft fallback. Claim the allowance only on actual establishment. NEW concentration up to sixty elapsed seconds replaces Core's preserved Instantaneous metadata. The target repeats WIS at each actual regular END, including a current turn's upcoming END; outside initiative use the shared END-only cadence. An ending save requires no Action and can occur despite the dance.

NEW all Actions means every otherwise available full Action opportunity on any actual turn while this application is operative, including a genuinely granted extra full Action. The compulsory behavior is dancing as that full Action, resolved before a contradictory voluntary full-Action choice under the existing mandatory-budget procedure. Its priority is the Dance application's establishment time, retained through its duration. It grants no extra Action, performance success, movement allowance, attack, Dodge, casting or other Action task. A full Action spent dancing cannot simultaneously be an incompatible ordinary Attack/skill/casting Action merely because the player describes an attack as rhythmic. A narrowly defined extra attack that is not a full Action remains subject to its own actual triggering permission; this spell does not relabel it as an Action or grant its missing trigger.

Bonus Actions, Reactions, ordinary movement, speech and concentration are distinct and remain available under their normal rules. An extra turn does not supply a new ending save, but any real full Actions during it are still subject to the existing Dance. The spell cannot force a character to spend an optional resource that would grant an extra Action; if the character voluntarily obtains a new full Action while the restriction operates, that Action must satisfy the same actual mandatory instruction arbitration. An Action already legally committed before Dance established is not retroactively canceled, and already-resolved effects are never undone. Newly available uncommitted full Actions after establishment are covered. An earlier incompatible genuine compulsion can win its own shared budget through the existing priority rule; that does not dispel Dance or refund its hard-control claim.

Dancing uses whatever harmless motor motion the creature's actual body permits. Missing legs, Prone, a grapple or Speed zero does not grant automatic immunity or a fresh save; it attempts the dance with available motion and still spends the affected full Action. If all bodily motion is externally prevented but the creature otherwise has an available full Action, the compelled attempt still occupies that Action without moving its body, breaking an anchor or applying paralysis. Actual Unconscious/Incapacitated states retain their own stronger absence of permissions; this source never supplies a new Action to a creature that has none. No Speed reduction, attack advantage, saving-throw disadvantage, extra loss of concentration or forced self-harm is added solely from the dance. A source requiring future voluntary full-Action upkeep may fail through its own missed-upkeep rule; ordinary concentration alone is not such an Action.

For a companion on an original-owner attached chassis, NEW apply the compulsion only to an Action its real ordinary attached phase actually supplies, substituting the dance for that action without creating a new phase, commanding the owner to pay a Bonus Action or granting another offensive activation. Already-paid owner costs and structural reservations are not refunded when a pending attack becomes the incompatible action. Its repeat WIS save occurs at that actual original-owner regular attached phase's END, with no new creature START/END or resource refresh; a missing phase supplies no fabricated save or Action, while the original sixty-second maximum continues. Multiple Dance applications retain their own concentration, save and deadline records. A single genuine dance Action can satisfy their compatible demands without multiple charges to one Action budget. Suppression releases the demand while its clock/saves and consumed Action history persist; resumption affects only still-available future opportunities. Actual removal, expiry, target death or concentration loss ends that source, never returning the already spent hard-control allowance.

completeCurrentCard.procedure:
KEEP Action, 60 feet, V/S/F and all three alternatives: asleep, panicked or sickened. Preserve Core Instantaneous as a metadata conflict. NEW declare one perceived creature with line of effect and one of the three modes before commitment/hidden outcomes. The creature makes initial WIS against the actual class DC; success establishes nothing. On failure attempt only the declared mode, concentration up to 60 elapsed seconds. No mode switch, free repeated gaze, additional target or later retargeting Action is granted. Another attempt requires a genuinely new paid spell, with normal concentration displacement and encounter histories.

ASLEEP: impose actual magically caused Unconscious, including its real inherited Incapacitated, awareness, movement, speech, held-item, Prone, saves and attack consequences subject to actual component immunities. This whole-Action effect claims the shared hard-control allowance once on establishment; an initially blocked application produces no alternative fear/sickness. Actual magical-sleep or Unconscious immunity applies within its stated scope. End this Eyebite sleep application when the target receives positive post-defense/pre-temp-HP damage, when another creature in physical reach spends an Action rousing this application's sleeper, on a successful ending save, or at the spell's ordinary end. If the helper cannot distinguish multiple Eyebite sleep sources, select one in neutral stable application order; this is not ordinary Sleep's separate all-Sleep wake rule. The waking attack resolves its actual hit/critical using the prior conditions before its damage wakes the target. Fully prevented zero damage does not wake; temp HP or a floor does not negate a real positive defended damage event. Awakening clears no unrelated Unconscious, zero-HP state or other source.

PANICKED: NEW actual Frightened toward the caster, plus a movement-only flight instruction while that relation is operative. At each future actual regular target START after normal processing, the creature must spend as much of its currently available ordinary movement as safely possible increasing distance from the caster's actual location known to that creature. With no actual known source location or no safe legal increasing-distance route, it makes no compelled movement and gains no secret locator. Use its real mode, terrain costs and remaining budget; actual controller chooses safe route details. It cannot be forced to Dash, spend an Action, expend RP/charges, leap into known serious danger, abandon valuable property or divulge secrets. Movement can provoke normal opportunity attacks; it is not push/pull. This soft mode claims no whole-Action guard. Fear immunity/suppression prevents or suspends the linked flight instruction as well as Frightened. Outside initiative use the existing shared six-second control cycle without replaying a passed START; an attached companion uses only a real existing phase and no fabricated off-screen cycle. Earliest actual instructions arbitrate shared movement.

SICKENED: NEW impose actual Poisoned, meaning disadvantage on attacks and ability checks under the current condition, without creating a toxin, consumable, infection, disease, new exhaustion track or automatic ongoing damage. Actual Poisoned immunity blocks it; disease-only or ordinary inhalation protection does not automatically block this magical condition source. No fear or whole-Action restriction is added, so no hard-control claim is made. Its real condition cure/removal rules apply. These definitions keep the source's three options distinct instead of silently treating Panicked/Sickened as nonexistent Core names.

Each established mode permits a WIS ending save at every actual regular END, including the upcoming END of a current turn, using the shared END-only/specific companion bridge. The Asleep save is expressly allowed without an Action or conscious self-rousing; its WIS is not a STR/DEX automatic failure. A successful save ends only that application. Damage does not independently end Panicked or Sickened. One active Eyebite per caster/recipient; genuinely established later same-caster Eyebite replaces that caster's older one, while different casters' modes retain independent saves, concentration and actual compatible condition effects. Any applicable stronger prevention still retains its scope. Suppression suspends the affected mode while clock/saves and used movement/control histories persist; no missed flight or drop-held-item event is replayed on return. Target death, concentration end, actual removal or original expiry ends the remaining source. No mode heals, stabilizes, resets resources, gives the caster private thoughts or changes actual faction standing.

Generic shared wording that selects named targets, ordered target lists or a target-centered area at commitment describes a direct casting; it does not override ordinary Ready's express target/area selection at release. A legal Ready preparation fixes the spell, acquired school/version, mode and other actual preparation-bound choices, pays its casting transaction and resolves its single counter window. completeCurrentCard.procedure:
KEEP Universal rank6,Action,60feet,V/S/F,base13RP and automatic activation of another spell. NEW one nonconcentration frame on one actually willing perceived living creature, including self, with line of effect. Fix the same bound identity and complete trigger at wrapper commitment. Successful formation starts original24elapsed-hour expiry and a60-second loading deadline. One frame, empty or loaded, per original caster; only a successful new formation replaces the old. A failed/countered wrapper pays but does not replace. These lifetimes are expressly new instead of Core Instantaneous.
LOAD: the original caster, within60feet/LoE, commits one actual separately acquired rank0-5 ORDINARY spell with one-Action casting time. It must actually be legal NOW to target the bound creature alone or place its complete declared area origin/center on that creature; Self-only requires bound=caster. Fix full spell/grant, mode, same target or bound-area policy, any explicit exclusions, shape, components, resource costs and source-specific choices BEFORE its counter window. Satisfy native touch/range/life/consent/material prerequisites; the frame does not provide them. It cannot store a nonspell class heal, object-only glyph, missing profile, unpriced material effect or unresolved discretionary payload. Real spell-tagged class cards remain outside this expressly ordinary-storage design rather than being charged as ordinary aliases.
Pay the payload's real Action, RP/material/HP/uses, components, Dissonance/Refrain, concentration transition and beginning hooks once at LOAD; wrapper13RP does not include it. The first legal loading commitment consumes the loading opportunity. A countered/negated load ends that frame with no refill/refund. Known ineligible load does not commit and can be corrected before the original deadline. After its counter window the same ORIGINAL cast is stored unresolved. For a concentrating payload prospective loading concentration displaces the old source; successful storage then relinquishes only that prospective burden. Storage holds no concentration and never restores the displaced old source. Loading-time rank, legitimate class parameters, required costs and explicit choices are immutable; future target defenses/eligibility, current lawful geometry and source-specified resolution-time quantities remain current. Payload duration starts on actual release. Independent use/capture deadlines are not extended by the frame.
TRIGGER: one observable future event or at most three declared simple predicates in fixed AND/OR logic; ordinary sight/hearing within30feet of the actual bound body with real cover/environment, plus the explicit LOCAL sensor of that body's own positive-to-zero HP crossing, positive defended-damage event or Unconscious transition, or one fixed future deadline strictly before frame expiry. No intent, alignment, private external inventory, spell rank or unavailable senses. Fix actual observer/eye/ear body points; no wall penetration or sight inside an opaque body. No sensing feed is sent to the caster. Arm only after successful LOAD; an old event or already-true predicate is never replayed. State predicates need a real false-to-true transition after arming.
QUEUE: at the beginning of the independently occurring external event capture the finite set of genuinely armed frames. Complete that entire damage/healing/cast/command event, its native source-owned children and survival/death/concentration consequences before any queued frame output. Evaluate its recorded observable facts, then in immutable establishment/identity order atomically consume each qualifying frame and payload before attempting release. NEW cap: at most one Contingency release ATTEMPT per original caster per actual numbered round; outside initiative require six elapsed seconds from that caster's previous attempt, preserving both interval/round histories through a mode transition. No reset through relabelled encounter or callbacks. A matching frame when the allowance is spent is consumed without a queued later chance. A release invalidated after reservation keeps that reservation spent. Recursively caused events can examine only the original finite prearmed set, each frame at most once; newly created/loaded frames cannot join that dispatch chain. A payload cannot create/load another automatic store, replay/copy an existing stored cast or generate another Action/turn window through an unaccepted route.
RELEASE: after the causing event, recheck same identity, lawful payload eligibility, actual source protections and original clocks. Use a declared current body point on the bound creature as the automatic spell origin; fixed single recipient is that creature, or its original predeclared area center/origin follows that body. No new chosen recipient, exclusion, mode, source grant or retargeting. Original caster remains dealer/controller. Self restrictions remain. A dead/ineligible recipient consumes failure without resurrection. A nonconcentration payload may release with an unconscious but living original caster and conscious or unconscious eligible recipient; caster death ends the frame. Caster and bound body must have an actually established same-plane relation, without inventing a plane or granting a private diagnostic.
For concentrating output, before resolution require the original caster conscious and actually able to concentrate within60feet/LoE; replace its then-current incompatible concentration once. If ineligible, consume without an effect. A successful automatic release is NOT a new cast, Action, Reaction, payment, component/cadence event or counter window. The original successful-resolution hooks run once only when their genuine predicate is met. Actual removal/defenses remain real counterplay.
NEW SOURCE-ROOT CHECKPOINT: LOAD creates the stored cast and its payment/selection receipt but no unperformed damage root. At actual release when an original payload creates each genuine damage/healing operation, create its native source-owned root then, with the ORIGINAL caster and that caster's real Null state at this root's creation. Keep its shared rolls, target application identity and already-frozen flags through redirects/descendants. This is a Contingency-only mapping, not alteration of Mental Prison's one admission root or Spectral Army's later-discharge rule. Other source-owned quantities/currency use the actual paid LOAD basis, never wrapper+payload nominal total. No duplicate callback or release ID can create another root, consumption or reward.
Suppression disables real frame sensing/release while original deadlines run. The frame remains actually removable at its bound-body application under a source-qualified rank-six interface. It does not create an empty-position anchor. Expiry/true removal cancels the frame and unresolved payload permanently. A missed transient event is lost; resuming while a state is already true is not a new transition. A sole fixed deadline missed during suppression/inactivity consumes the chance, not delayed firing. An armed frame with other still-available declared future predicates can remain until its genuine ending, without replay. At equality the frame's original expiry precedes trigger admission. No storage may outlive an earlier applicable native permission.
GRAVE GIFT is current accepted ordinary rank5 source, not an unnamed ordinary heal. At LOAD its donor must have at least2normalHP, pay floor(currentHP/2) plus actual10baseRP, and its other actually willing living ally must ALREADY be0HP Dying/Stable. The frame grants no automatic unconscious consent. Healthy-target preload is illegal before payment. A positive-to-zero trigger requires real recovery then a NEW drop after arming; loading at0 does not replay the prior drop. A changed future-deadline example must be labelled changed. At release direct max-HP recovery is not ordinary healing: preserve Wounds/Critical, independent Prone, actual broad HP-gain prohibition, source-specific False Life optional Insight/d2 gate and separately authorized stabilization with one actual original Stable deadline. Ordinary class Healing Rite may be a separately paid intervening recovery but is not a stored ordinary payload. No Cure Wounds or unspecified spell is invented.
Glyph of Warding remains its complete distinct paid surface/finite-payload source: it does not supply this frame's creature binding,24-hour duration, separate load, remote origin or new root mapping. All of these storage permissions are explicitly local new authorship, not proof of a generic temporal/cast scheduler.

completeSharedRules.classification: INHERIT with explicitly named local exceptions
completeSharedRules.title: Actual acquisition and paid commitment
completeSharedRules.wording: All five use their complete native classAccess row: actual class level, school, rank and base RP; no total-level, discounted-price or same-name substitution grants access. V requires real audible speech, S a usable hand or a real exception, F the actual focus; source-authorized exemptions retain only their scope. An illegal uncommitted declaration spends nothing. A legal commitment spends its real Action/Bonus Action/Reaction permission, actual final RP/material/HP/charge price, components and source-use ledgers once, sets any prospective concentration and ends incompatible old concentration before interruption, then updates actual chronological casting-family, Dissonance/Refrain and beginning hooks before its Counterspell window. Ordinary success, failure, countering and later ineligibility refund nothing. A resumed parent never overwrites an intervening Reaction cast's later history. Save DC and attacks use the actual generating class and acquired automatic features. All preparation-bound identities, modes, timestamps and costs are recorded before their window; ordinary Ready's target/area selection occurs at legal release, without another payment or counter window. No spell here grants its required anatomy, inventory, repertoire, proficiency, extra Action or physical support.

completeSharedRules.classification: INHERIT plus explicit per-spell clock registrations
completeSharedRules.title: Markers, life and idempotent event history
completeSharedRules.wording: Bind absolute time and source/recipient original regular START/END markers separately. A future target END excludes an already-underway target turn; a source next START means its first future original regular START. Preserve that clock through reordering, absence, suppression and initiative changes under the accepted virtual-marker rule; outside-initiative one-round registrations use the specified original elapsed six seconds, never a reset on entering initiative. Expire START-ending effects before refresh; then actual Reaction/recharge, legal already-due life recovery, death save, other required START events and only then voluntary decisions. END damage/saves/maintenance precede END-expiry. A resolved marker/event cannot be repeated. A real full Action grant retains its original cap and recursive-grant restriction. No new generic timeline, Time Loop restoration, world rewind, turn duplication or source reset is selected. Every fixture explicitly supplies its schedule and ordinary-round identity; elapsed seconds alone are not a universal round-number formula.

completeSharedRules.classification: NEW LOCAL common wording only for Absolute Zero and Chrono Lock
completeSharedRules.title: Finite body suspension, not generic Incapacitated
completeSharedRules.wording:
When one of these two spells actually establishes its suspension, the same active creature is unaware, cannot speak, choose voluntary behavior, act, use Bonus Actions/Reactions, move, command or perform voluntary upkeep. Hold the actual body and currently worn/carried inanimate equipment at its current pose. Other carried/mounted creatures are not suspended by association. Existing external supports can break; ordinary gravity, forced movement and ordinary teleportation cannot relocate the held body while operative. A source explicitly overriding this suspension remains an exact exception. No attack advantage, automatic STR/DEX failure, adjacent critical, Prone, Stunned or generic Incapacitated is implied.
The held body/gear admits no new bodily damage, healing, temporary HP, conditions, direct HP loss, transformation or physical alteration. An otherwise legal paid attempt may resolve no bodily payload; nothing is banked. Distinguish genuine damage prevention from loss of source eligibility. Every actual due periodic opportunity is consumed once even when its bodily payload is prevented; independent source clocks, END saves for an existing source, scheduled source cleanup, mandatory form ending and world state continue. A mandatory anatomy ending can become a pending body-normalization consequence until interaction resumes; it never resets that source's timer or grants a new form.
Death saves due during operative suspension are marked skipped without a roll, success or failure and cannot be rerolled for that same regular marker later. Absolute Stable recovery remains its ORIGINAL due deadline: while HP gain is blocked keep a due-blocked record, not a new d4 or renewed delay. After suspension, the first genuine legal recovery checkpoint under the existing life/START ordering resolves that original opportunity once. No new recovery is granted by this spell. Explicit world-timed lethal tracks and their real death rules continue: a genuine lethal track transition can kill despite prevented damage/HP change, and true death/removal ends this application. Immediate biological aging, respiration expenditure and metabolism pause; elapsed world calendars, actual deprivation/debt/history continue, and there is no food, water, rest, work, study or recovery credit.
Existing concentration is not lost merely because this is not Incapacitated. Actual deadline, source dependency, unpaid upkeep, death or another real ending still ends it. Body-emitted aura/technique output and optional command/control are unavailable while held; completed independent fields/projectiles and other bodies retain their actual sources. Missed emissions do not queue. A required further personal action cannot complete; a completely committed independent effect resolves only if its own continuing predicates remain.
The temporal application remains a real rank-six removable/suppressible effect at the actual body. Eligible removal requires its real source target/range/perception or actual area-capture interface; no hidden locator is granted. Actual suppression restores ordinary interaction while the original deadline and hard-admission record continue. Resumption before that deadline captures the same surviving active identity at its CURRENT real pose, not its old position; it heals nothing, resets nothing and never spends another hard guard. An actually ended/dead/removed source cannot resume. On final ending real unsupported height uses the existing Falling marker. No detachable ice, material stock, stored-damage burst, native-plane or soul claim is created.

completeSharedRules.title: Actual witnesses and bodies
completeSharedRules.wording: Use actual occupied bodies, perception and source-qualified line of effect; another actor's ally status does not make its body transparent. Cases declare Medium5x5x6 occupied boxes with x/y foot center and z bottom only as synthetic physical inputs. A direct creature range uses the ordinary occupied-body distance and an actual clear witness; point spells use one real selected caster point to that declared point. Fireball keeps literal20-foot cast range and20-foot radius. A declared path/witness is not proof of an unauthenticated campaign collider. Time Skip's return uses same-anchor, legal squeeze, then only an actually reachable nearest adjacent placement in the same unobstructed region, stable minimum-displacement/overlap/neutral order. With none, absence still ends into an explicit returned-placement conflict, not further invulnerability, remote teleportation, crushing damage or a new body. Permanent gear/corpse identity and actual custody are conserved.

completeSharedRules.classification: INHERIT; Contingency-specific new checkpoint stated in its procedure
completeSharedRules.title: Actual life operations and original source ownership
completeSharedRules.wording: Do not merge normal damage, HP costs, ordinary healing, direct recovery, stabilization, temporary HP and resurrection. Actual instant death, Wounds, Critical, independent conditions and recipient gates resolve in their source order. Immunity to one damage type is not immunity to suspension. Null retains its real original-dealer root-creation snapshot and exceptions; a controller, bound recipient, redirect recipient or callback is not a replacement dealer. Only an actual source grants a new root, reflection, secondary healing or resource event. These procedures introduce no sixth Fate/information presentation, revive no spent entitlement and do not authenticate synthetic source facts. The accepted Grave Gift direct-recovery and independent stabilization/False Life gates remain exact.

completeSharedRules.classification: INHERIT; NEW local finite receipt schema
completeSharedRules.title: Durable local entitlements
completeSharedRules.wording: Record cast ID, selected grant, paid base/extra/HP values, targets/modes, real commitment and outcome times, immutable clocks, interruption stack, source/recipient identity and consumed slot/attempt histories. Local hard-control keys are original caster/target/genuine encounter, shared with that character's actual whole-Action denial. Only actual establishment spends that guard. Local Time Skip bonus and Contingency release ledgers are separate permissions, not encounter resets, general Action-grant ledgers or copied-feat allowances. Save/reload and duplicate callbacks preserve receipts. A new application ID cannot launder a prior original-source entitlement; callback ID is never a payment/recovery key. Runtime atomicity remains an implementation obligation, not proved by authoring these finite records.
